Ava: Quick sync — Zephyrcase customer story: need final quotes, legal sign-off, and webinar slot. Target publish Tues 5/21. Doc here: https://docs.redwood.com/zephyr-customer-story (internal). Who can own approvals?
Ben: I can own production + final asset. Quick Q: do we have a one-line hero quote from Mark at Zephyr?
Diego: Hey team — Mark's out today but he approved this line over email: 'Redwood cut our inference cost in half and made our search 3x faster.' Happy to get formal sign-off.
Elise: :thumbsup: that reads strong. Marketing ask: can we tighten to 'cut our inference cost by 50% and made search 3x faster' — legal ok?
Carla: Added redlines in the doc. Main ask: remove exact %s unless customer signs off in writing. Also need org-level approval and trademark check. I pinged Zephyr legal.
Ben: Okay — Diego, can you get that signed in an email? We can publish under embargo once we have it.
Diego: On it. I'll loop Zephyr legal. ETA EOD today.
Ava: Plan for webinar: propose Wed 5/29 10am PT. Speaker list: Mark (Zephyr), Priya (our PM), and me moderating. Thoughts?
Elise: Works for me — will run analytics + registration page. Need 30-day nurture flows set up.
Ben: I'll prep demo clip + 5-slide highlight deck. Where to drop assets? /shared/marketing/zephyr/assets
marketing-bot: Reminder: Press embargo policy requires a signed quote + 24h pre-announce window. See https://redwood.company/policy/embargo
Carla: Zephyr legal just replied: they can approve numeric savings if we include 'as measured by' clause pointing to internal benchmark. Diego, can you confirm measurement phrasing?
Diego: They approved this phrasing: 'as measured by Zephyr's internal A/B benchmark (Q1)'. They emailed greenlight. I'll paste the signed email into the doc.
Ava: :party_parrot: Great. Once email's in doc Ben, go ahead and lock the hero quote and I'll request final legal stamp.
Ben: Locked hero quote in doc and uploaded the final transcript. Also exported a short 30s clip: s3://redwood-marketing/zephyr/clip1.mp4
Elise: Created webinar event in HubSpot, draft landing page live: https://redwood.hubspot.com/zephyr-webinar — needs copy tweaks.
Ava: Copy tweak suggestions: lead with outcome, add a pull quote on hero banner, and CTA 'Register - limited seats'. I'll push edits by 2pm.
Carla: Final legal approval: uploaded signed email and added 'as measured by' line. All good from legal.
Diego: Zephyr OK to publish under embargo Tue 5/21 9am PT. Mark will be on the webinar.
Ava: Confirmed. Publishing timeline: Tue 5/21 9am PT publish blog + hero post, Wed 5/29 webinar. Folks — please confirm you have what you need. :eyes:
Elise: Got it. I'll turn on registration and set up nurture.
Ben: :thumbsup: assets in place.
marketing-bot: Publication scheduled: 1725493200 -> Tue 5/21 09:00 PT (scheduled).
